recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片低倍下散布細長針狀、淡藍色的細胞外結晶（黃色箭頭），高倍可見結晶旁有許多漿細胞（偏心核、核周淡染區、嗜鹼性細胞質）；λ 免疫染色在結晶周邊著色，提示單株免疫球蛋白結晶沉積。
features: Low-power aspirate smear with scattered extracellular needle- or rod-shaped crystals (arrows) among cellular marrow particles
Crystals are elongated, pale blue to clear, refractile and of variable length, lying free between cells (panel B)
Increased plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clock-face chromatin, perinuclear hof and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Background trilineage hematopoiesis with maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors
Panel C: lambda IHC shows peripheral staining of a rod-shaped crystal on the biopsy, with lambda-positive plasma cells nearby
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show cellular particles with an increase in plasma cells, which display eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear clearing, admixed with maturing hematopoietic elements. Numerous extracellular, elongated needle- to rod-shaped pale blue crystals of variable length are present between cells. On the core biopsy, lambda immunostain decorates the periphery of a rod-shaped crystal and highlights adjacent plasma cells. With 27% clonal lambda-restricted plasma cells and an IgG-lambda paraprotein, findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm (smoldering multiple myeloma) with extracellular crystalline immunoglobulin deposition.

ddx.vs: Urate crystals are needle-shaped and strongly negatively birefringent under polarized light, dissolve in aqueous fixation, and do not stain for immunoglobulin light chains.
In crystal-storing histiocytosis the crystals are intracellular within CD68+/CD163+ histiocytes rather than lying free in the extracellular space.
Charcot-Leyden crystals are bipyramidal/hexagonal and associated with abundant eosinophils, not with light chain-restricted plasma cells.
Contaminants lie in a different focal plane over cells, are uniform and non-biological, and do not show light-chain immunoreactivity on tissue sections.
